report: Form I-140 by Fiscal Year, Quarter and Case Status
scope: Quarterly receipts by beneficiary country and preference; useful as a current-demand flow signal, but not an India priority-date inventory
model_use: The forecast uses the companion FY2026 Q3 India country workbook's approval-by-fiscal-year series as the future-demand proxy; quarterly receipts are preserved for provenance and are not added to queue depth.
